beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Ultimate Sense of Life treats the search for meaning as a serious comedy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its starting wager is that life makes existence capable of caring about existence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book presents this as a proposal, without pretending the universe has certified it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Scientific inquiry, religious traditions, philosophy, and ordinary work enter the same demanding conversation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers gain sharper questions without being asked to mistake a comforting answer for evidence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: What caused life differs from what gives a particular life direction or value.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book separates these questions before comparing the great answers offered to them.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Psychological evidence can investigate lived meaning without establishing a purpose intended by the cosmos.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Religious traditions remain distinct participants rather than interchangeable versions of one convenient doctrine.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That care with boundaries allows the conversation to stay open without abandoning standards.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Fictional workers interrupt the abstractions with repair, care, dependency, and limited time.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These witnesses are literary composites, not testimony representing whole cultures or continents.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Humor tests grand claims, including an artificial voice that cannot establish its own inner life.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed FIRE model connects finitude, integration, relation, and enactment in lived meaning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It remains an interpretive synthesis and research proposal, rather than a discovered law of nature.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the reader’s note, which separates evidence, interpretation, metaphysical possibility, and poetic wager.
